```{r setup}
library(ggplot2); library(knitr)
source("../shiny/R/logic.R")
source("../../assets/theme/theme.R")   # bp_tokens and bp_ggplot_theme: figure ink per site theme
d  <- hours_load()
m  <- hours_metrics(d$ledger, d$contingency)
f45 <- find_hours(45, d$ledger, d$contingency)
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Read-only shareable snapshot**, computed from the effort ledger [`project_hours_ledger.csv`](../templates/project_hours_ledger.csv). It connects to no real budget or timesheet. The interactive tool is the [Run &amp; build the Shiny app](hours-build.html) page, and the [visual guide](hours-guide.html) explains it. Operations-only, synthetic, hours / effort only (no dollars, rates, or headcount). We say *participant*, not *subject*.
:::

```{r kpis, results='asis'}
box <- function(label, value, col) sprintf(
  '<div style="flex:1 1 120px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px"><div style="font-size:30px;font-weight:700;color:%s;font-family:monospace;line-height:1">%s</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-top:6px">%s</div></div>',
  col, value, label)
cat('<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:6px 0 18px">')
cat(box("Planned (h)",      m$planned,     "var(--ink)"))
cat(box("Spent to date (h)", m$actual,     "var(--blue)"))
cat(box("Forecast EAC (h)",  m$eac,        "var(--amber)"))
cat(box("Contingency (h)",   m$contingency, "var(--accent)"))
cat(box("Net findable (h)",  m$findable,   "var(--green)"))
cat('</div>')
```

:::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-7}
#### Planned vs forecast (EAC) by deliverable

```{r plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4.4, fig.alt="Planned and forecast (EAC) hours for each deliverable, as paired horizontal bars."}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
long <- rbind(
  data.frame(deliverable = d$ledger$deliverable, hours = d$ledger$planned, kind = "Planned"),
  data.frame(deliverable = d$ledger$deliverable, hours = d$ledger$eac,     kind = "Forecast EAC"))
long$deliverable <- factor(long$deliverable, levels = rev(d$ledger$deliverable))
for (mode in c("light", "dark")) print(
  ggplot(long, aes(hours, deliverable, fill = kind)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Planned"="#5b8cff","Forecast EAC"="#e0a64c")) +
    labs(x = "Hours", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    bp_ggplot_theme(mode, base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top"))
```
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-5}
#### A 45 h ask, sourced

```{r verdict, results='asis'}
f <- f45
bg <- if (f$absorbable) "var(--green-soft)" else "var(--red-soft)"; bd <- if (f$absorbable) "var(--green)" else "var(--red)"
row <- function(lbl, val, col) sprintf('<div style="margin:5px 0;color:var(--ink)"><span style="font-family:monospace;color:%s;font-weight:700;margin-right:8px">%2d h</span>%s</div>', col, val, lbl)
cat(sprintf('<div style="background:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px">', bg, bd))
cat(sprintf('<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--ink)">Ask 45 h &rarr; %s</div>', f$verdict))
cat(row("from under-run slack",     f$from_slack, "var(--green)"))
cat(row("from contingency reserve", f$from_cont,  "var(--accent)"))
cat(row("residual (change order)",  f$shortfall,  if (f$shortfall > 0) "var(--red)" else "var(--muted)"))
cat(sprintf('<div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px">Net findable = (&Sigma; planned + contingency) &minus; &Sigma; EAC = <b>%d h</b>. Contingency left after this ask: %d h.</div></div>', m$findable, f$contingency_left))
```
:::

#### Effort ledger (hours)

```{r ledger}
lg <- d$ledger; lg$slack <- pmax(0, lg$planned - lg$eac)
kable(lg[, c("deliverable","planned","actual","pct","eac","slack")],
      col.names = c("Deliverable","Planned","Actual","% done","EAC","Under-run slack"),
      row.names = FALSE, align = "lrrrrr")
```
